notes: Yes for every n >= 2: Akopyan-Avvakumov-Karasev, every planar convex body has a fair convex partition into m parts (Adv. Math. 2026). TOPP page still says open. Outside Lean: the cited theorem (equivariant topology).

sources.cite: A. Akopyan, S. Avvakumov, R. Karasev, Convex fair partitions into an arbitrary number of pieces, arXiv:1804.03057, Adv. Math. 493 (2026)
sources.what: every convex body in the plane splits into m convex parts of equal area and perimeter, all m >= 2 (abstract read)
